Officer sleeves come in two sizes (standard / smaller); the figure shows no measurable difference, so one size is built.","provenance":"measured from CAPR 39-1 Fig A5-1 (gray) and A5-6 (blue); CAP lettering cleaned from traced glyphs; grade pieces are this family's own assets","colours":{"gray":"#5f5c5c","blue":"#142347","cap":"#dddcdb","stripe":"#b3b3b3"},"anchors":{"top_center":[98.3,0],"bottom_center":[98.3,384.3],"center":[98.3,192.15],"left_edge":[0,192.15],"right_edge":[196.6,192.15],"cap_center":[98.3,88.0943820224719]},"dimensions":{"form":"slip-on epaulet sleeve","length_in":3.843,"end_width_in":1.966,"button_end_width_in":1.719,"cap_word_w_in":0.997,"cap_word_h_in":0.34,"grade_bottom_from_end_in":0.625,"grade_bottom_note":"DAFI 36-2903 7.1.5.1: 5/8 in from the end of the epaulet; figure shows 0.63-0.71 in","grade_orientation":"upright","grade_pieces":"1 silver stripe(s)"},"mounts":[{"uniform":"Class B blue shirt (long/short sleeve, men and women)","rule":"slipped over the shirt epaulet; officers gray with embroidered grade, cadet officers blue with miniature metal grade (CAPR 39-1 4.1.6.1.1, 4.1.6.1.4).
